polish_measurement.duplicate_disclosure: The paper currently has TWO AI-disclosure sections: 'AI Assistance Disclosure' (4 lines, placed before the bibliography) and 'AI assistance in this work' (14 lines, placed after it). The second subsumes the first. Only one is machine-checked: scripts/verify_paper_claims.py line 509 requires the string 'AI assistance in this work' in the rendered PDF text layer.
polish_measurement.epigram: 'Determinism is not reproducibility.' appears verbatim twice, once in the figure caption and once in section 3.1. It is the paper's thesis and it is backed by 0.0000% repeated-run CV against 78.16% cross-seed CV.

polish_measurement.invariant: No number, citation, \ref or \label changes in any option. The gate scripts/verify_paper_claims.py (138 checks) must stay at 137/138 with only the designed-red untracked-file check, and the PDF must be rebuilt and its hash re-derived.

next_action.instructions: An 8-page academic paper body contains 48 em-dashes across 220 sentences. A de-AI style guide lists em-dash overuse as a tell and recommends replacing them with commas, colons, parentheses or sentence breaks. 34 sites can be converted with no change to meaning, numbers or references; the remaining 14 are places where the dash carries a genuine interruption. Reviewers read the PDF, and the deadline is in 40 hours.
